items.html: Thus it is found that AVI are rooted also in the male, which is the Hochma of Arich, except that it was in unity; and they are also both rooted in the female, the Bina of Arich, except that it was in separation, in two names of Ehyeh. It has thus been explained that everything is a single phase, and whatever is in the Garon is in the Hich [palate], although in the Garon it is doubled compared to the Hich, for a single drop from the Hich is as much as the two drops of the Garon, except that in the Garon they were divided into two for the aforementioned reason.
